info.name: FFP - Fit For Purpose API
info.description:
Multi-tenant physiotherapy assessment and workout programme platform.

**Architecture:**
- AWS Lambda + API Gateway v2 (HTTP API)
- Region: eu-west-2 (London)
- Authentication: Cognito JWT

**Authentication:**
Protected endpoints require JWT token with custom claims:
- `custom:tenantId` - Tenant identifier
- `custom:role` - User role
- `custom:customerId` - Customer identifier (for users under customer organisations)

**Phase:** Sprint 1 (Foundation Infrastructure)
**Developer:** Christopher Tregaskis

item.name: Health & Status

request.description:
Public health check endpoint - no authentication required.

Returns:
- `status`: Health status ("healthy")
- `message`: Service identification
- `timestamp`: Current server time (ISO 8601)
- `service`: Service name
- `version`: API version

**Status Codes:**
- `200`: Service is healthy
- `500`: Service health check failed
